contract.I: Known/unknown WorkRef, actual authenticated Agent principal and ActorRef, current Host Work revision, Actor Attention ChangeSequence, and per-Topic MessageSequence

contract.S: No new Host storage: existing PostgreSQL Work/Social/Attention owns all native semantic records; Harness owns actual Agent invocation lifecycle

contract.post: Only needed current Work/Topic pages consumed, Work CAS resolves exact revision and does not silently overwrite concurrent Agent; acknowledgement occurs after page consumption
contract.inv: No change-sequence/message-sequence exchange; no ack of unconsumed event or Topic message; participation is not IAM, Work is not Runtime truth; Work/Topic links require known real business association
contract.eff: Read only until actual Agent action; optionally write Message and Work CAS; distinct cursor acks only after consumed pages, never arbitrary service effect

contract.epsilon: No independent two-Principal Agent handoff yet; no automatic Harness hook; workload latency/failed-resume probability UNKNOWN
